adds.title: Anchorage municipal LGBTQ anti-discrimination ordinances and Proposition 1
adds.summary: The Anchorage Assembly approved nondiscrimination protections covering trans people in 2015, Proposition 1 on the April 2018 Anchorage ballot would have required people in public spaces to use bathrooms and locker rooms matching their sex assigned at birth rather than gender identity, and Anchorage voters rejected Proposition 1 by 53-47% so the 2015 protections remained in place.

adds.title: Ketchikan City Council anti-discrimination ordinance
adds.summary: Ketchikan City Council unanimously voted to ban anti-LGBTQ discrimination.
